outline: Overview of the regulatory, social, environmental and economic impacts of sustainable planning, design and construction inclusive of a detailed analysis of demand-side sustainable design and construction systems as well as an overview of supply-side renewable energy generation.
schedule:
Class Schedule:
1.	Introduction to USGBC & GBCI
2.	Sustainability & the Process
3.	Conservation to Codification
4.	LEED for Neighborhood Development
5.	Design Low Carbon Neighborhoods
6.	Social, Regulatory & Legal Considerations
7.	Sustainable Rating Procedures & Systems
8.	Water Efficiency
9.	Midterm Exam
10.	Energy & Atmosphere
11.	Materials & Resources
12.	Indoor Environmental Quality
13.	The House as a System
14.	Foundations, Framing, Insulation, Roofing Windows & Doors
15.	Plumbing, HVAC & Electrical Systems
16.	Life-Cycle Environmental Analysis
17.	Life-Cycle Cost Analysis
18.	Final Exam
assessment:
Homework	10%
Midterm Exam	20%
Semester Project	40%
Final Exam	30%
